The Problem

Building data infrastructure costs more than you think.

Websites deploy anti-bot systems. Your scrapers break. Engineers spend time maintaining infrastructure instead of shipping features.

Constant Maintenance

Websites change layouts, deploy CAPTCHAs, and update anti-bot measures. Your scraper breaks every few weeks.

Hidden Complexity

Proxy management, rate limiting, data cleaning, error handling. The real work starts after you extract HTML.

Engineering Time

Your best engineers maintain scraping infrastructure instead of working on your core product.

Our Approach

We handle everything. You get reliable data.

Custom Built

We design data pipelines specifically for your requirements. No generic templates.

  • Tailored to your exact data needs
  • Clean, structured output format
  • Delivered on your schedule

Fully Managed

We monitor, maintain, and optimize continuously. You don't think about infrastructure.

  • 24/7 monitoring and alerts
  • Automatic adaptation to changes
  • Direct support from engineers

We own the outcome. If your pipeline breaks, we fix it. If quality drops, we catch it.
